lines.zh: 月下的蕨叶擦过我脚踝。
lines.en: Moonlit ferns brush my ankles.

lines.zh: 木杖点地，一步一步巡林。
lines.en: My staff taps the ground as I patrol.

lines.zh: 脚步声惊起夜里的虫鸣。
lines.en: My steps stir the insects of the night.
The jungle's shadows hide me.
Potion vials clink at my waist.
I tread on rotting leaves toward camp.
Vines part as I shuffle on.
Night dew wets my bare feet.
Two zombies trail behind me.
Mist drifts along with me.
I count the tree shadows as I go.
Branches rustle above my head.
Purple bubbles rise in my cauldron.
I stir the thick, venomous brew.
I chant low words none understand.
I sniff the bitterness on my fingers.
Moonlight falls on my pale face.
I click the bone beads one by one.
Only insects break the jungle quiet.
I stare into the little fire.
My nails trace the staff's carvings.
I wait for the night to deepen.
A living one, walking into my woods?
Your complexion suits my experiments.
Hold still, let me read your pulse.
Another traveler unafraid to die.
In the jungle night, the smell of iron stands out.
I know that look in your eyes.

lines.zh: 站住，林子的规矩你懂吗？
lines.en: Halt, do you know the jungle's law?

lines.zh: 你把脚印留在了我的路上。
lines.en: Your footprints stain my path.

lines.zh: 面具下的眼睛泛着绿光。
lines.en: Eyes under my mask glow green.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，借我用用。
lines.en: Whatever you hold, lend it to me.
These old bones can't take that.
You dare strike a shaman?
Painful, but I will remember.

lines.zh: 我的药瓶碎在地上，冒紫烟。
lines.en: My vial smashed, purple smoke rising.
A wound for a curse, fair trade.
My blood is dark, but it flows.
Don't think I've lost my footing.
I only gave half a step.
A vial shattered at my feet.
You will pay a dearer price.
Is that fresh herb I smell?
Bring it closer, I rarely bite.
That scent recalls my old furnace.

lines.zh: 你竟带着这种东西进林？
lines.en: You brought such a thing into the woods?
Don't put it away, let me look.

lines.zh: 手上的东西，够换一瓶药。
lines.en: That could trade for one potion.
I catch something sweet...

lines.zh: 祭品放地上，别举这么高。
lines.en: Put the offering down, don't hold it so high.

lines.zh: 这味道勾得我喉咙发痒。
lines.en: The smell makes my throat itch.
You know how to please a witch.
Spill my brew and you will pay.
Don't brush against my robe.

lines.zh: 退开，你踩到我的影子了。
lines.en: Back off, you stepped on my shadow.
That bump rattled my old bones.
No one stands this close to a shaman.
You broke my chant with that shove.
Keep your hands off my bone string.
Bump me again and I curse you.
The path is wide, yet you crowd me.
My staff is not a walking stick.
The dead have no courtship.
Ask the living about such things.
My only partner is this cauldron.
Outside the rite, keep your distance.
A corpse's heart does not stir.
You picked the wrong one, traveler.
I am wed to this rainforest.
Rites are for the full moon.
Put that look away.
Affection rots, spells do not.
This heart belongs in my pot.
Whatever lands is mine.
Iron nuggets? Good for a brew.
I stoop to lift that faint glimmer.
Someone dropped this, how careless.
The page's letters are still legible.
This bundle smells of magic.
The box is mine, walk on.
My knuckles close on the find.

lines.zh: 林子里没有白捡的东西。
lines.en: Nothing in the jungle is free.
Found you, living one.
Don't run, the brew is still warm.
This range is perfect for a throw.
You stepped into my hunting ground.
First, taste the purple one.
Zombies, keep your eyes on him.
I see your shoulders tremble.
The spell is already tied to you.

lines.zh: 腐心在胸腔里敲了一下。
lines.en: The rotten heart in my chest thumps once.
You can't hide in the tree shadows.
This vial was mixed for you.
Your breathing gives you away.
The prey delivered itself.
Tonight a living soul is offered.
Don't look back, I'm behind you.
Lift, aim, throw.

lines.zh: 你躲得了一次，躲不了三次。
lines.en: Dodge once, not three times.
The poison mist will catch you.

lines.zh: 绕树也没用，我熟这片林。
lines.en: Circling trees won't help, I know this wood.
Stand firm, don't fall in the mud.

lines.zh: 我的僵尸挡住了你的退路。
lines.en: My zombies block your retreat.
This one will make your limbs weak.
The brew should be working now.
Your blade swings slower each time.

lines.zh: 再近一步，就进我的圈子。
lines.en: One more step and you're in my circle.

lines.zh: 药水瓶在指间转了一圈。
lines.en: A potion flask turns between my fingers.
Don't hope for dawn, it's early yet.
A purple flash, you should step back.
The jungle is helping me.

lines.zh: 你踩碎枯枝的声音太响。
lines.en: Your snapping twigs are far too loud.
Two zombies shuffle behind me.
This vial is for your companion.
You are already inside my poison ring.
My staff cracks against your knee.
Take this blunt blow.
My nails rake across your arm.
Back off, don't touch my face.
I smash a vial at your feet.
My bone string whips your shoulder.
Block my hand, not the poison.
This strike leaves a mark.
The sound of wood on bone.
The poison mist arrives first, then my bone staff.
Don't fall yet, we're not done.
My staff is old, but heavy.
Poison is crawling through your blood.
Guard high and I strike your wrist.
This slap sends you into the mud.
Does it hurt? Then it's right.
The night is thick enough for me.
Footsteps near from the deep rainforest.
I step out from the tree shadow.
My vials glow in the dark.
Two zombies claw up from the soil.
The moon knows my face.
The jungle insects fall silent.
My staff sweeps the rotting leaves aside.
I arrive with a bitter scent.
Someone lit a fire they shouldn't.
A new shadow joins the mist.
My staff lands, the chant begins.
The forest yields the path to me.
Tonight it's my turn to patrol.
The flames tighten my skin.
My knees click first as I land.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我咳出药味。
lines.en: Water fills my throat, I cough up potion.
The blast overturns my cauldron.
Your arrow pins my shoulder.
Spell clashes spell, my teeth numb.
Hunger makes my grip slip.
Lightning strikes, my bone string chars.
The void gnaws at my ankles.
